label: Text With Icon
purpose: Up to 3 short icon + text pairs in one item, inside a horizontal ticker
_notes:
icon_N names a material-icon (e.g. 'local_shipping', 'verified_user'). text_N is inline_richtext (no

tags) — a short phrase, not a sentence. At minimum fill icon_1/text_1; use 2 and 3 for a multi-item badge row. Leave custom_icon_N empty '' unless you specifically want an image instead of the named icon. Distinct from text-with-icon (hyphenated) used elsewhere — this one is horizontal-ticker's own version.
